objective: Move the owner-facing Live2D/VTube Studio and Spout2 dashboard page out of legacy App.vue into a dedicated typed Vue component while preserving Electron main as the only owner of the VTube Studio token, WebSocket transport, Spout bridge and typed IPC.
non_goals: Do not change the VTube Studio Public API protocol, authentication token storage, RFC-6455 transport, hotkey/movement allowlist, Spout sender allowlist, bridge lifecycle, transparent capture behavior or VRM fallback.
Do not add a dependency, direct renderer WebSocket, direct renderer network or file access, new external port, model asset, or real VTube Studio/Spout smoke against the owner's active desktop.
Do not migrate Avatar/Runtime in this slice.
contracts: Live2DPage is typed presentation only. It receives bounded VTube Studio/Spout status and emits fixed owner intent; it does not import Electron, Node, WebSocket, direct network APIs, persistence or bridge runtimes.
App.vue and Electron main remain the sole owners of typed VTube Studio IPC, token lifecycle, authentication, fixed hotkey/movement dispatch, Spout polling and bridge error logging.
The page never receives authentication tokens, raw VTube Studio protocol frames, a WebSocket handle, arbitrary hotkey/model/movement payload capability, or raw Spout pixels.
The VTube Studio and Spout fallback/loopback/allowlist invariants remain unchanged; markup extraction must not change connection behavior.
Desktop security tests include the extracted page and retain all operator-only IPC and no-direct-network assertions.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue 3/TypeScript, current Electron typed IPC and repository test tooling; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All Live2D/VTube Studio dashboard markup is removed from App.vue and rendered through pages/Live2DPage.vue.
The extracted page preserves status, explicit connect/disconnect/refresh controls, fixed hotkey/movement controls, Spout status and safety/asset explanation through typed props/emits only.
Dashboard module documentation records Live2DPage as extracted and names remaining legacy pages accurately.
Desktop typecheck, desktop security/build test and the repository fast gate pass without generated test artifacts retained.
